blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Smartphone clinical images provide a low-cost data source for computer-aided skin lesion classification in resource-constrained settings, but images alone cannot fully capture patients' medical histories and lesion symptoms. To address the lack of structured organization among heterogeneous clinical variables, the ambiguity between observed and imputed values, and the risk that clinical information may interfere with visual evidence, we propose GAMF-Net, a grouped availability-aware multimodal fusion network. Ten clinical variables are divided into three semantic groups---demographics, history-related risk, and lesion presentation---and each group jointly encodes field values and field-level availability masks. The image branch produces the base classification logits, while each clinical group generates image-conditioned class-level residual evidence. Only available groups participate in availability-normalized equal-weight fusion; when all clinical information is unavailable, the model reduces exactly to the image-only pathway. We evaluate the method on PAD-UFES-20 under a patient-disjoint five-fold protocol with separate training, validation, and test partitions. GAMF-Net achieves an Accuracy of $74.17\pm2.85\%$, a balanced accuracy (BACC) of $70.11\pm2.11\%$, a Macro-F1 of $68.85\pm0.85\%$, and a Macro-AUROC of $93.42\pm1.20\%$, outperforming all image-only and multimodal baselines reimplemented under a unified protocol. Compared with the strongest baseline, MetaBlock, the corresponding improvements are 2.37, 2.59, 4.14, and 1.02 percentage points, respectively. Ablation results show that clinical information substantially improves class-balanced performance, constrained equal-weight fusion is more effective than dynamic fusion, and the lesion-presentation group provides the most informative clinical complement.
blocks.zh: 智能手机临床图像为在受资源限制的环境下计算机辅助的皮肤损伤分类提供了低成本数据源,但仅凭图像无法完全捕捉患者的病史和损伤症状. 为了解决不同临床变量之间缺乏结构组织的问题、观测值和估算值之间的模糊性以及临床信息可能干扰视觉证据的风险,我们建议建立GAMF-Net,这是一个分组的可用性-认识多模式聚变网络。 10个临床变量分为3个语义组——人口学组,历史相关风险组,以及损伤呈现组——每个组联合编码场值和场级可用口罩. 图像分支生成基础分类日志,而每个临床组群生成图像有条件的类级残留证据. 只有可用群体参与可用性正常的等重聚变;当所有临床信息都无法获得时,模型就完全缩小到只有图像的路径. 在PAD-UFES-20上, GAMF-Net的精确度为74.17\pm2.85\$,平衡精度(BACC)为70.11\pm2.11\$,宏-F1为68.85\pm0.85\$,宏-AUROC为93.42\pm1.20\$,优于统一协议下重新执行的所有图像和多模式基线. 与最强基线MetaBlock相比,相应的改进分别为2.37,2.59,4.14和1.02个百分点. 膨胀结果显示,临床信息大大改善了类平衡性能,受限的等重聚比动态聚变更有效,损伤-呈现组提供了最丰富的临床补充.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Deep convolutional neural networks have demonstrated strong performance for automated skin lesion recognition on curated clinical and dermoscopic image collections [ 15 , 17 ] . Nevertheless, most widely used public benchmarks, including HAM10000, are dominated by dermoscopic images acquired under comparatively controlled conditions [ 33 ] . Smartphone clinical photographs are easier to acquire in primary-care and resource-constrained settings, but they exhibit greater variation in illumination, background, camera distance, device type, and lesion scale. PAD-UFES-20 was introduced to support research in this less controlled setting by providing smartphone images together with patient- and lesion-level clinical variables [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 深演化神经网络在所培养的临床和皮肤图像收集中表现出了自动识别皮肤损伤的强效性能[15,17]. 尽管如此,最广泛使用的公共基准,包括HAM10000,主要是在相对控制条件下获得的皮肤图像[33]。 智能手机临床照片更容易在初级保健和资源受限的环境下获得,但它们在照明、背景、相机距离、设备类型和损伤规模方面表现出更大的差异。 引入PAD-UFES-20是为了通过提供智能手机图像以及患者和损伤级临床变量[30],支持这种控制较弱的设置的研究.

blocks.en: Clinical decision-making relies on information that is not always visually observable, such as age, previous cancer history, anatomical location, growth, bleeding, pain, and elevation. Multimodal learning provides a general framework for combining complementary sources of evidence [ 1 ] . In skin lesion analysis, prior studies have explored image–metadata concatenation, metadata-conditioned feature modulation, and attention-based interaction. Yap et al. combined multiple imaging modalities with patient metadata [ 35 ] ; Li et al. used metadata-derived coefficients to reweight visual feature channels [ 25 ] ; and MetaBlock introduced an attention-based metadata-processing block for image feature enhancement [ 29 ] . Subsequent studies have explored more expressive interactions using multimodal Transformers, MDFNet, and the cross-attention-based MMF-Net [ 4 , 6 , 28 ] . Although these approaches confirm the value of clinical context, they generally encode heterogeneous variables as a single vector or allow metadata to directly perturb visual features.
blocks.zh: 临床决策依赖于并非始终可见的信息,如年龄、以前的癌症史、解剖位置、生长、出血、疼痛和高程。 多式联运学习为结合补充证据来源提供了一个总的框架[1]。 在皮肤损伤分析中,之前的研究探索了图像-元数据结合、元数据条件特征调制和基于注意力的相互作用。 叶普等人. 将多种成像模式与病人元数据相结合[35]; 李等编. 使用元数据衍生系数来重新加权视觉特征通道[25];而MetaBlock为图像特征增强引入了基于注意力的元数据处理块[29]. 随后的研究探索了利用多式联运变换器、MDFNet和跨意向的MMF-Net[4、6、28]的更多表达式互动。 虽然这些方法证实了临床环境的价值,但它们一般将各种变量编码为单一矢量或允许元数据直接扰动视觉特征.

blocks.en: A further difficulty is incomplete clinical information: standard imputation produces fixed-dimensional inputs but does not indicate whether a value was observed or imputed. MetaBlock-SE represents available metadata with sentence embeddings and evaluates robustness under simulated and real missingness [ 2 ] , while TIP develops image–tabular pre-training for heterogeneous and incomplete tabular data [ 14 ] . More generally, explicit missingness masks can provide information beyond imputed values [ 5 ] . These methods motivate availability-aware modeling, but preserving an independent visual decision path while incorporating semantically grouped clinical evidence remains insufficiently explored.
blocks.zh: 另一个困难是临床信息不完整:标准估算产生固定维度输入,但没有表明一个值是否被观察到或被估算. MetaBlock-SE代表了可用元数据,其中句子嵌入,在模拟和真实缺失[2]下评价稳健性,而TIP则开发图像-表格式预训,用于不同和不完整的表格式数据[14]. 更广泛地说,明显的缺失口罩可以提供超出估算值的信息[5]。 这些方法激发了对可用性的认知模型的建立,但是,在纳入精密分类的临床证据的同时,仍然没有充分探讨保持独立的视觉决定路径。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose GAMF-Net, which organizes ten clinical variables into groups representing demographic information, history-related risk, and lesion presentation. Each group is encoded together with field-level availability masks. The image branch first produces a complete set of six-class logits, and each clinical group then generates image-conditioned class-level residual evidence; only available groups participate in normalized equal-weight fusion, so clinical information supplements rather than replaces the image prediction.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立GAMF-Net,将10个临床变量组织成代表人口信息、历史风险和病情描述的组别。 每个组都配有现场可用口罩。 图像分支首先产生一套完整的六级对数,每个临床组再生成图像有条件的类级剩余证据;只有可用组参与正常化的等重聚,因此临床信息补充而不是取代图像预测.

blocks.en: The main contributions are as follows: • We introduce medically motivated semantic grouping and field-availability-aware encoding to jointly model clinical values and their observation states. • We develop an image-anchored class-level residual fusion mechanism in which clinical groups provide complementary corrections, while the model reduces exactly to the image-only pathway when all clinical groups are unavailable. • We conduct a unified evaluation on PAD-UFES-20 using patient- and lesion-disjoint five-fold splits, including image-only models, multimodal baselines, and fusion/input and clinical-group ablation comparisons.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献如下: 我们采用医学动机的语义分组和现场可用性编码,以联合示范临床价值及其观测状态。 我们开发了一种图像预留级残余聚变机制,临床组提供补充矫正,而当所有临床组无法使用时,模型完全缩小成图像唯一的路径。 我们对PAD-UFES-20进行统一评价,采用病人和损伤的五倍分化法,包括只图像模型、多式联运基线、聚变/输入和临床组群的萎缩比较。

blocks.en: We introduce medically motivated semantic grouping and field-availability-aware encoding to jointly model clinical values and their observation states.
blocks.zh: 我们采用医学动机的语义分组和现场可用性编码,以联合模拟临床值及其观测状态。

blocks.en: We develop an image-anchored class-level residual fusion mechanism in which clinical groups provide complementary corrections, while the model reduces exactly to the image-only pathway when all clinical groups are unavailable.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一种图像预留级残余聚变机制,其中临床组群提供补充矫正,而当所有临床组群都无法使用时,模型则完全缩小到图像唯一的路径.

blocks.en: We conduct a unified evaluation on PAD-UFES-20 using patient- and lesion-disjoint five-fold splits, including image-only models, multimodal baselines, and fusion/input and clinical-group ablation comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们对PAD-UFES-20进行统一评价,采用病人和损伤的五倍分化法,包括只图像模型、多式联运基线、聚变/输入和临床组群的萎缩比较。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Image-Based Skin Lesion Classification
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于图像的皮肤剥离分类

blocks.en:
Deep learning has substantially advanced automated skin lesion
classification. Esteva et al. demonstrated dermatologist-level
discrimination on selected tasks using convolutional networks trained
on large clinical image collections [ 15 ] .
Han et al. further investigated benign and malignant cutaneous tumor
classification using standard clinical photographs rather than
dermoscopic images alone [ 17 ] . For dermoscopic
analysis, HAM10000 provides 10,015 multi-source images and remains
a major benchmark for multiclass lesion recognition [ 33 ] . These studies establish the effectiveness
of image-based learning, but they do not directly address the greater
acquisition variability and richer clinical context associated with
smartphone images.

blocks.en:
PAD-UFES-20 contains 2,298 smartphone clinical images from
1,373 patients and 1,641 lesions across six classes, together with
up to 21 clinical variables [ 30 ] . The dataset is
strongly class-imbalanced and may contain multiple images of the
same lesion, so patient- and lesion-disjoint evaluation is necessary
to prevent information leakage and obtain a realistic estimate of
generalization performance.

blocks.en: 2.2 Fusion of Images and Clinical Metadata
blocks.zh: 2.2 图像和临床元数据合并

blocks.en:
Multimodal learning includes early fusion, late fusion,
representation alignment, and modality-conditioned interaction [ 1 ] . In skin lesion classification,
direct concatenation is a common baseline, but it does not explicitly
distinguish the roles of visual and clinical evidence. Yap et al. showed that clinical metadata can complement multiple skin-imaging
modalities [ 35 ] . MetaNet uses a metadata network
to generate channel-wise modulation coefficients for visual features [ 25 ] , whereas MetaBlock employs an attention-based
metadata-processing block to enhance image representations [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh:
多模式学习包括早聚变,晚聚变,
表示方式的调整和有条件的方式互动 [1]. 在皮肤损伤分类中,
直接交接是一个共同的基准,但没有明确
区分视觉和临床证据的作用。 叶普等人. 显示临床元数据可以补充多种皮肤成像
模式[35]。 MetaNet 使用元数据网络
生成视觉特性的频道调制系数[25],而MetaBlock则使用基于注意力的调制系数
元数据处理块,用于增强图像表达 [29].

blocks.en:
More expressive fusion mechanisms have subsequently been proposed.
Cai et al. introduced a multimodal Transformer for image–metadata
fusion [ 4 ] ; MDFNet combines skin images and
clinical information through a dedicated multimodal diagnosis
framework [ 6 ] ; and MMF-Net employs intra-modality
self-attention and inter-modality cross-attention for bidirectional
interaction [ 28 ] . These methods strengthen cross-modal
communication, but their additional flexibility can complicate
optimization on small and imbalanced datasets. In contrast,
GAMF-Net preserves an explicit image decision pathway and introduces
clinical information as group-specific residual evidence at the
logit level.

blocks.en: 2.3 Incomplete Image–Tabular Data
blocks.zh: 2.3 图像不完整 - 表格数据

blocks.en:
Incomplete clinical information poses a further challenge because
measurements may not be collected, verified, or retained during data
curation; conventional imputation preserves a fixed-dimensional input
but does not indicate whether each value was observed or imputed. GRU-D demonstrated that explicit masks and missingness
patterns can improve healthcare prediction beyond conventional
imputation [ 5 ] . Although GRU-D addresses multivariate
time series rather than image–metadata fusion, its treatment of
observation states supports explicit availability indicators.

观察国支持明确的可用性指标。

blocks.en:
MetaBlock-SE extends MetaBlock using sentence embeddings and
evaluates robustness to incomplete metadata on PAD-UFES-20 and an
extended clinical dataset [ 2 ] . TIP addresses
a broader image–tabular setting through masked tabular
reconstruction, image–tabular matching, and contrastive pre-training [ 14 ] . Rather than reconstructing or semantically
embedding missing values, GAMF-Net directly exposes field
availability to each clinical group encoder and excludes completely
unavailable groups from residual fusion.

blocks.en: 2.4 Recent Advances in Medical and Consumer Imaging
blocks.zh: 2.4 医疗和消费者形象方面的最新进展

blocks.en:
Medical image computing has increasingly relied on generative and
learned priors for reconstruction and synthesis [ 7 , 9 , 11 ] ,
and visual enhancement has been extended to robot-assisted
surgery [ 24 ] . Low-level restoration studies address
document contamination removal [ 12 ] , facial
shadow removal [ 36 , 27 ] , cinematic filter
emulation [ 19 ] , and underwater [ 10 ] and infrared imagery [ 8 ] . On the multimodal side, recent
work has examined robustness to attention sinks and positional decay
in large vision-language models [ 37 ] ,
redundancy-aware cross-modal emotion
recognition [ 20 ] , manifold-guided interaction in consumer
devices [ 34 ] , and persona-driven speech
synthesis [ 23 ] . Further studies cover counseling
alignment [ 21 ] , 4D Gaussian splatting
compression [ 22 ] , and compositional concept
extraction [ 31 ] . None models the
field-level availability of heterogeneous clinical variables, the
focus of GAMF-Net.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和评价协议

blocks.en: PAD-UFES-20 contains 2,298 smartphone images from 1,373 patients and 1,641 lesions [ 30 ] , distributed as 730, 845, 52, 244, 192, and 235 images in the ACK, BCC, MEL, NEV, SCC, and SEK classes, respectively, resulting in substantial class imbalance.
blocks.zh: PAD-UFES-20包含来自1,373名患者和1,641名损伤[30]的2,298张智能手机图像,分别以730,845,52,244,192和235张图像在ACK,BCC,MEL,NEV,SCC,SEK班级中发行,导致班级严重失衡.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Representative smartphone clinical images of the five skin lesion classes in PAD-UFES-20.
blocks.zh: 图 2:PAD-UFES-20的五种皮肤损伤类具有代表性的智能手机临床影像.

blocks.en: We use a fixed patient-disjoint five-fold cross-validation protocol: in each fold, three folds are used for training, one for validation, and one for testing, containing 1,371–1,391, 449–475, and 449–475 images, respectively, with no patient or lesion shared across subsets. The preprocessor is fitted only on the training subset, the best model is selected based on validation BACC, and the selected checkpoint is evaluated once on the test subset. Final results are reported as the mean and sample standard deviation across the five test folds.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个固定的患者-脱节的五倍交叉验证协议:在每一个折叠中,三个折叠用于训练,一个用于验证,一个用于测试,分别包含1,371–1,391,449–475和449–475图像,没有患者或损伤在子集之间共享. 预处理器仅安装在训练子集上,根据验证BACC选择最佳模型,选定的检查点在测试子集上评价一次. 最终结果报告为五个测试折叠的平均值和样本标准差。

blocks.en: 4.2 Compared Methods and Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 比较方法和执行细节

blocks.en: We compare GAMF-Net against Image-only ResNet18, Direct Concat, MetaNet [ 25 ] , Dynamic Feature Modulation, MetaBlock-SE [ 2 ] , and MetaBlock [ 29 ] ; Direct Concat is a conventional early-fusion baseline, and Dynamic Feature Modulation a unified metadata-conditioned feature-modulation baseline. All reimplemented models use the same patient-level splits, class order, field-exclusion rules, preprocessing procedures, and validation-based model-selection criterion.
blocks.zh: 我们比较GAMF-Net与仅图像的ResNet18,Direct Concat,MetaNet [25],动态特性模块,MetaBlock-SE [2],以及MetaBlock [29]; Concat是常规的早期聚变基线,而动态特性调制是统一的元数据条件特性调制基线. 所有重新执行的模型都采用相同的患者级别划分,类序,场排除规则,预处理程序,以及基于验证的模型选择标准.

blocks.en: GAMF-Net uses a ResNet18 pretrained on ImageNet with an input resolution of 224 × 224 224\times 224 and a batch size of 32. AdamW [ 26 ] is used as the optimizer, with learning rates of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} for the backbone and 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} for the newly added modules and a weight decay of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . We use a OneCycle learning-rate schedule motivated by super-convergence training [ 32 ] , train for at most 100 epochs with early stopping (patience 15), set the random seed to 2026, and enable automatic mixed precision. Experiments use Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.7.1, CUDA 12.6, and an NVIDIA Tesla V100 32GB GPU.
blocks.zh: GAMF-Net在ImageNet上使用ResNet18预训,输入分辨率为224×224/224\times 224,批量大小为32. AdamW [26]作为优化器使用,主骨的学习率为1×10−5 1\times 10×5}新添加的模块为1×10−4 1\times 10×4 4}重量衰减为1×10−4 1\times 10×4}. 我们使用一个以超联赛训练[32]为动机的OneCycle学习-速率计划,最多100个有早期停站(patience 15)的时代的列车,将随机种子设定到2026年,并允许自动混合精度. 实验使用Python 3.10,PyTorch 2.7.1,CUDA 12.6,以及一种NVIDIA Tesla V100 32GB GPU.

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价计量

blocks.en: We report Accuracy, BACC, Macro-F1, and Macro-AUROC. BACC is appropriate for imbalanced classification because it averages class-wise sensitivity [ 3 ] . It is defined as follows: BACC = 1 C ​ ∑ c = 1 C Recall c . \mathrm{BACC}=\frac{1}{C}\sum_{c=1}^{C}\mathrm{Recall}_{c}. (16)
blocks.zh: 我们报告准确性、BACC、Macro-F1和Macro-AUROC。 BACC适用于不平衡的分类,因为它平均具有等级敏感性[3]. 定义如下: BACC = 1 C → c = 1 C 召回 c.\mathrm{BACC → frac { 1} → C → sum_{c = 1 → C → mathrm {召回}_{c }. (16个)

blocks.en: Because the dataset is class-imbalanced, validation BACC is used for model selection. Class-wise recall and AUROC are also reported to analyze minority-class discrimination across decision thresholds [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 由于数据集是类平衡的,因此用于模型选择的验证BACC. 另据报告,分类召回和AUROC还分析跨越决定阈值的少数群体阶级歧视。

from 73.31 % 73.31\% to 78.81 % 78.81\% and AUPRC from 21.55 % 21.55\% to 24.20 % 24.20\% , but does not improve SCC precision, recall, or F1 under
the default argmax decision rule. MetaBlock remains stronger for
SCC-specific recognition (recall of 42.71 % 42.71\% , F1 of 34.89 % 34.89\% , and
AUROC of 83.34 % 83.34\% ). Thus, the overall Macro-F1 improvement of
GAMF-Net does not represent a uniform gain across all classes.

Of the 192 SCC samples, 64 are correctly classified; of the 128
errors, 96 cases ( 75.00 % 75.00\% ) are predicted as BCC and 27 cases
( 21.09 % 21.09\% ) as ACK, and the confusion is partly reciprocal, with 148
BCC samples assigned to SCC. The main class-level limitation is
therefore the decision boundary between SCC and BCC rather than
uniformly poor ranking across all lesion categories.

blocks.en: 5.4 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.4 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
The experiments support four main observations. First, structured
clinical information substantially improves overall and class-balanced
recognition over the image-only baseline. Second, the constrained
availability-normalized fusion outperforms the evaluated dynamic
fusion variant. Third, the compact ten-field profile performs
comparably to the full 21-field input, and the lesion-presentation
group provides the strongest clinical complement. Semantic grouping
supports clinical organization and group-level interpretation, while
the image anchor preserves a separate visual pathway and class-level
residual corrections; the ablations characterize the evaluated
configurations rather than isolate each component.

配置而不是孤立每个组件。

blocks.en:
This study has several limitations. PAD-UFES-20 was collected from a
specific population and acquisition setting, so generalization across
devices, regions, and institutions remains unverified, and the
availability-aware formulation has been evaluated only under the
naturally occurring missingness distribution rather than under
progressively increasing field absence or systematic removal of
entire clinical groups. In addition, SCC recognition remains
substantially weaker than recognition of the other classes, primarily
because of SCC–BCC confusion. Finally, the patient-clustered
bootstrap quantifies uncertainty due to test-patient sampling but not
variability across repeated training runs; external validation and
repeated-training analysis would be required for stronger conclusions
about generalization and optimization stability.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We proposed GAMF-Net, which combines smartphone skin lesion images
and structured clinical information through semantic grouping,
field-availability-aware encoding, and image-anchored class-level
residual fusion.
Under a patient- and lesion-disjoint five-fold protocol, GAMF-Net
achieves the highest mean Accuracy, BACC, Macro-F1, and
Macro-AUROC under the unified protocol, with the patient-clustered
analysis providing the strongest evidence for a consistent Macro-F1
improvement over MetaBlock. Constrained equal-weight fusion is more
effective than the evaluated dynamic fusion variant, while the
compact ten-field profile retains performance comparable to the full
21-field input.
Future work will focus on SCC–BCC discrimination, structured
missing-data scenarios, and validation across backbones, devices,
and institutions.
